def run_scenario(seed_range, label='scenario', match_stale=0.1, per=3):
    fails = 0
    tally = {}
    for seed in seed_range:
        request = gen.build_scenario_request(seed * 71 + 3, per=per)
        try:
            ref.align_revisions(request, random.Random(seed), stale=match_stale)
        except ref.Invalid:
            continue
        data = json.dumps(request, separators=(',', ':'))
        if not compare(data, 'scen %s %d' % (label, seed)):
            open('/workspace/dev/fail_scen.json', 'w').write(data)
            fails += 1
            continue
        s = stats(data, ref.run_json(data))
        for part in s.split():
            k, _, v = part.partition('=')
            if v:
                tally[k] = tally.get(k, 0) + int(v)
    print('%-16s fails=%d %s' % (label, fails, tally), flush=True)
    return fails
